london_game.notes: Colts.com states the London game vs Washington is designated an away game for Indianapolis, so the Commanders are the designated home team. Kickoff Sun Oct 4, 2:30 p.m. BST / 9:30 a.m. ET. Commanders fly Tuesday night (Sept 29), light practice Wednesday, fuller sessions Thursday/Friday in London. Colts' second London game ever (2016 vs JAX at Wembley).

WAS.week3_result: W 33-31 vs SEA (Sept 27) with Marcus Mariota starting

qb.backup: Jayden Daniels if cleared; otherwise reserves Sam Hartman / Athan Kaliakmanis (QB2 order not confirmed)
qb.notes: Daniels dislocated his left (non-throwing) elbow Sept 20 at Dallas, did not practice in Week 3 and was ruled out vs Seattle; Mariota started and threw multiple TDs (reports cite 3 or 4) in the 33-31 win. Daniels will not have surgery, is traveling to London and will practice 'in some form and fashion' this week; Dan Quinn has not committed to him playing. Specialists projected 'three weeks or sooner'. Unless Daniels takes most first-team reps, Mariota is the likely Week 4 starter. Mariota was named a captain.
